testCase:
R-26: Find the app for iOS.
Goal: Find the app for iOS.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-26/
STEP 2: Click "Accept all"
STEP 3: Click "Get the app" in the footer
STEP 4: Click "Download on the App Store" in the "iPhone and iPad" card
STEP 5: Verify "Opened: fakeduolingo.com on the App Store (iOS)" is visible

steps.note: Choose the iOS download in the correct card.

args.text: Opened: fakeduolingo.com on the App Store (iOS)

steps.note: Verify the exact iOS App Store confirmation is visible.

reasoning: This test checks that the iOS app download link opens the expected App Store destination message. The plan follows the supplied navigation and scopes the download link to the iPhone and iPad card before asserting the exact visible confirmation.
